text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: Severity 2 - GPU prefill OOM spike on pool-proxy-us-west-2. 24 OOMs / restarts in last 5m. Affected node: gpu-rt-07. Linking INC-7890. @oncall-sre please ack

jamal: ack, I'm on it. pulling logs and pod list now

kevin: seeing repeated CrashLoopBackOff on pod `redwood-serving-abc123` on gpu-rt-07. restartCount=6 in last 12m. nvidia-smi shows memory pinned at ~95%.

jamal: can you paste the prefill stacktrace? guessing long-context prefill overflow (user long prompts + large system messages)

kevin: logs: ```
2026-02-02T18:17:32Z error runtime: prefill failed for request id req_0x9f - CUDA error: out of memory
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.20 GiB (GPU 0; 15.90 GiB total capacity)
  at /workspace/runtime/src/prefill/prefill_executor.cpp:482
  kv_cache.growth=+2.3GiB over last request
```

jamal: confirmed GPU OOM during prefill path. This looks like a long-context request that caused KV cache blowup and didn't trim. Impact: requests to pool-proxy-us-west-2 with long contexts are failing with 503/500 and restarting containers.

maria: support: we have ~120 user errors in the last 10m. Top affected customer: AcmeCorp (prod-chat) showing elevated errors and timeouts. Opening ticket and pinging account team.

jamal: mitigation plan (live):
1) reduce concurrency on pool to avoid memory contencession: `rdwctl pools update pool-proxy-us-west-2 --concurrency=4`
2) enable prefill trimming on the pool to cap client-supplied prefill: `rdwctl pools update pool-proxy-us-west-2 --prefill-trim=true --prefill-max-tokens=4096`
3) create temporary routing rule to divert long-context traffic to smaller model variant: `rdwctl route add --from pool-proxy-us-west-2 --to pool-proxy-us-west-2-redwood-medium-v1 --match 'content_length>8192'`
4) restart problem pods one-by-one to drain node: `kubectl -n redwood delete pod redwood-serving-abc123` (will be recreated with new config)

ops-bot: automated action: added 2 spot GPU nodes to pool-proxy-us-west-2 (scale event id scale-20260202-1)

kevin: applying the `prefill-trim` toggle now. patching pool config. rolling update will restart pods gracefully.

jamal: doing `kubectl cordon gpu-rt-07` to stop new pods landing while we drain; then evict pods.

sarah: taking handoff @1705010000 — oncall SRE takeover. Jamal, status?

jamal: handing off. actions completed: concurrency reduced, prefill-trim enabled, routing rule created, two nodes added, problematic pods restarted. Waiting for 10m observation window.

kevin: after rolling update, restart counts dropped and OOMs fell to 0 in last 5m on this pool. `nvidia-smi` memory usage now 60-70% with headroom. No more CrashLoopBackOff.

maria: customer note: ACME support ticket INC-ACME-112 created, patch note: we throttled very long contexts and routed to smaller model temporarily. Will follow up with timeline once stable.

jamal: root-cause hypothesis: sudden surge of long-context sessions from a single customer triggered KV cache growth beyond expectations; prefill path didn't apply trimming for certain request variants (edge case introduced in recent perf patch). Eng-runtime to confirm.

kevin: filing an immediate hotfix PR to ensure prefill-trim defaults to ON for public pools and add extra guard to refuse >1M KV entries. linking PR: https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/4321

ops-bot: incident timeline created: INC-7890 | start=1705009876 | mitigated=1705010500 | nodes_added=2 | pods_restarted=8

support-bot: status page draft: "We are investigating increased errors for long-context requests to a subset of GPU nodes in US-WEST-2. Mitigations in progress; customers with production impacts are being contacted." Maria will post after approval.

sarah: next steps & owners:
- eng-runtime (kevin) to validate hotfix and deploy canary (owner: kevin)
- eng-ml to review KV cache growth patterns and model-side memory accounting (owner: jamal)
- support to notify top 5 affected accounts and advise on temporary token limits (owner: maria)
- postmortem and follow-up actions to be created in INC-7890 (owner: sarah)

jamal: planned permanent mitigations: default prefill trimming on by default, shorter default max prefill tokens, add per-request KV cap and early-fail with clear 4xx for massive contexts instead of crashing.

kevin: monitoring: added alert rule to fire if pod restartRate>3 in 10m for GPU pools and also added a metric for `prefill_kv_growth` to catch runaway growth early.

maria: AcmeCorp replied: thanks for fast response. They will temporarily limit client-side history to 6k tokens while you deploy fix.

sarah: marking this as mitigated for now. leaving incident open for postmortem and code fix. Great job team. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident INC-7890 updated: status=mitigated, severity=2, summary="GPU prefill OOM causing container restarts; mitigated by trimming + routing + scaling"

jamal: adding final note: make sure runbook `prefill-oom-handling` is updated with `rdwctl` commands we used and the `--prefill-trim` flag example.

sarah: will collect logs and schedule postmortem on Monday. closing thread for active paging.
